ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along leading and trailing edges; dense, high-contrast black circular mottling concentrated on the left lobe; symmetrical dark linear streaks radiating from the basal region towards the trailing edge on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the fluke apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration frequency; multiple small-scale peaks and valleys along the horizontal span; localized deep indentations visible on the upper-left lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp upward sweeps at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized dark circular pixel groups distributed across the white background of the left lobe; high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips (consistent with barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (vertical and diagonal rake-like marks) breaking the white pigmentation on the lower-middle portion of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; dense white pixel encrustations at both distal tips representing parasitic/barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in spot density, with significantly higher frequency of small focal black pixel clusters on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.
